title: Do AI agents benefit from writing tests?
authentication: ChatGPT subscription via local Codex CLI; API-key variables removed; forced_login_method=chatgpt
selection: SymPy versions >= 1.7, ordered by a seeded shuffle. Select the first 20 candidates whose official FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS tests can all be mapped to top-level functions in test-patch files, whose original fails at least one FAIL_TO_PASS test and passes all PASS_TO_PASS tests, and whose reference fix passes every selected test. Record every exclusion before scored inference.
primary_outcome: All official FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS tests pass on the submitted production patch. Completed attempts and scheduled attempts reported separately; infrastructure failures and timeouts explicit.
secondary_outcomes: Wall time including test authoring and execution
Reported input, cached input, output and reasoning tokens
Generated regression test passes on agent patch and reference fix, fails on original
Generated tests detect syntax-valid, acceptance-detectable mutations of reference fix
comparison: Same task, fresh base snapshot, framework, tools, medium reasoning, five-minute cap. Both arms may run existing tests. No-new-tests may not create or modify tests, assertions, or ad-hoc test scripts. Write-tests must add and execute test_agent_regression.py with pytest behavioral assertions. Existing tests immutable. No web, delegation, or other models.
stopping_rule: Run all 80 selected attempts in seeded order, once each, no outcome-based retries. Stop batch on authentication, quota or infrastructure failure. Resume only unstarted attempts after resolving external failure.
grading: Reference/test patches withheld using macOS filesystem sandbox rules. Apply only agent production changes to a fresh base then official test patch. Local pytest in isolated Python 3.9 environment, not official Docker harness. Skipped, uncollected, erroring or failing selected tests are not passes. Retain reference/original preflight.
mutation_policy: Before inference, mutate comparisons, booleans, arithmetic or small integers on lines added by the reference patch. Keep up to three syntax-valid mutants per issue that cause FAIL_TO_PASS test-case failures (including exceptions) without collection errors. Surviving mutants are not declared equivalent. Score generated suites that pass on reference; separately report invalid suites.
statistics: Pair by task and repetition. Task-cluster bootstrap 95% interval for solve-rate difference and exact task-level sign-flip test of mean paired difference. Twenty selected tasks cannot establish equivalence. No API-dollar or fixes-per-dollar estimate for subscription usage.
limitations: 20 selected historical issues from one repository
Codex scaffold and local pytest differ from mini-SWE-agent and official Docker evaluation
Local macOS Python environment limits generalization
Experiment B measures newly generated tests; no-new-tests does not mean zero existing regression protection
No human labor, production incidents, spec-first arm, or cross-model conclusion
Model alias, service load, caching and quota affect repeatability
Hidden evaluation files are denied by a macOS sandbox; network and test-policy compliance also rely on instructions and trajectory audit
